item.title: Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy Versus Conventional Radiation Therapy for Localized Prostate Cancer: 7-Year Results of the PACE-B Randomized Trial
item.description: Purpose: PACE-B randomized men with low/intermediate-risk prostate cancer to 5-fraction SBRT or conventional fractionation. Results: 7-year biochemical control was noninferior (HR 0.98).
